properties.notes: Site of a former council depot, now redundant and surplus to requirements. Comprising depot buildings and associated land close to the centre of Alnwick. Clearance and remediation required. Permission secured for construction of 61 dwellings (A/2005/0595). This follows demolition of the depot buildings. A mixed residential development is to be provided, comprises of 18 flats, 14 terraced houses, and a detached cottage, along with 28 sheltered housing apartments. The latter are specialist flats for the elderly, but are self-contained dwellings (C3). Scheme of 61 dwellings completed in 2019/20.
